final.T_equiv_note: Energy-matched mixture of local bound canonical distributions, weighted by surviving spatial populations; proxy only. None means no finite positive-temperature match.
final.energy_observable_note: Actual local excitation energies per survivor, including loss selection; axial n=0 is not the 3D ground state.

validity: maximum eliminated excited fraction across nodes and spin states = 0.0008208
max optical rate / smallest local motional angular spacing across all axes = 0.234
Synthetic measured-envelope fit RMS = 0.174; residual gamma = 0.000682/s. A poor fit is an unresolved calibration-model mismatch, not a validated intensity estimate.
Joint spin/nx/ny/nz populations retained, but emission projections factorized into Cartesian dipole marginals. Correlations of one photon's Cartesian recoil components are neglected.
Population-resolving scattering erases motional coherence and treats elastic spin amplitudes as distinguishable; this is an additional approximation beyond secular averaging.

Separable isolated wells with Gaussian local depths; no tunnelling, coherent Raman continuum excitation, envelope transport or recapture. Scalar trap basis with diagonal differential shifts; trap shape changes from spin-dependent shifts neglected.

Raman/trap Stark operators use diagonal matrix elements; static off-diagonal motional dressing and trap-basis changes are omitted. Excited-state lattice shifts of the pumping transitions remain the configured common optical shift.
4 frozen Gaussian position / uniform registration samples. Refine samples and time_step_us for convergence; samples are numerical quadrature, not experimental error bars.
Axis temperatures are energy-matched bound-state mixture proxies; transverse survivor cooling may result from preferential loss.
